title: Reading a post on the phone
question: Bar settled: one Insert button. Now the post page itself (feedback #88: "incredibly barren looking"). Every option fixes the basics: real space between paragraphs, a proper type scale, headings that look like headings, highlight, strikethrough, footnotes gathered at the end. A post with pictures still leads with them (the strip, as you picked on 13 November); these show a post with no picture at the top, the barren case. The difference is the top of the page and how a split into cards (=== on its own line) reads.

options.label: A quiet band when there's no picture
options.thesis: With no picture to lead, the top is a navy band carrying where it's from (Church news or the ministry) and the title; who wrote it and when sit under it, then the text. A split into cards is a sand bar across the page between the parts.
materials: branded band in place of a picture
options.viewport: Church news band with the title, Church office · Saturday 14 November, the text with a list and quote, a sand bar, then Helping on the day.
options.risk: Every picture-less post gets the same navy top, so they can look alike.

options.label: A reading page
options.thesis: Type carries it: a small accent kicker (Church news · Sat 14 Nov), a large title, the author row over a hairline, the first paragraph a little larger as a lead. A split into cards is a short row of dots with space around it.
options.viewport: Kicker, the title over two lines, the author row, the lead paragraph, the list and quote, three dots, then Helping on the day.
options.risk: The quietest; a short post is still mostly white.

options.label: Each part a card
options.thesis: The post sits on sand: a heading card (a navy-to-teal stripe, where it's from, the title, the author) and then each part of the post its own white card, pictures running to the card's edges. === starts a new card.
options.viewport: The heading card, a card with the opening text, list and quote, the next card starting Helping on the day with its picture.
options.risk: A post without splits is one long card, and the cards add a frame around everything.
